pev.first: Whispering Vale
Up. You were sleeping like you meant it.
Training dummies are south-east. Hit one.

pev.text: Hit the training dummies in the yard.

pev.first: Swing. Then dodge. Then try your Q skill.

pev.text: Follow the path north to the Elder Plaza.
Checkpoint: Whispering Vale

pev.first: The Stone knows her. The Stone does not say.
The Stone lost a light. Past the cottage, a path ends.

pev.text: Open the chest west of the glade. Then find the Stone's lantern.

pev.first: A chest! Interact to open it.
That glow? Keep it. Gear remembers you.
Open your bag and equip it.

pev.text: The Stone's lantern, still warm.
Return the lantern to the Elder Stone.
A hidden gem cache!

pev.first: Four Wardens. One would not wake.
The Stone is lit. The Stone remembers kindness.

pev.text: Reward: a gem and a Socket Rune.
Gloom in the garden
The garden is quiet. Something hums in the south.
The Pinewood rift opens

pev.first: The Pinewood screams. Let's be rude back.

pev.text: Take the rift south into the Misty Pinewood.
Checkpoint: Rift terrace
Checkpoint: Whispering Vale

pev.first: Misty Pinewood
The animals are running.
Everything with legs is leaving.

pev.text: Follow the animals north along the dirt road.

pev.first: The wall hums, Aerin. Something is hidden behind it.

pev.text: A hidden gem cache!
Ogre!
Heavy footsteps echo to the north...
The Gnarlroot Ogre (south-east, by the loop road) holds the Hollow key. The road north leads to the plaza
Checkpoint: The road to the plaza
Checkpoint: The road to the plaza
Gnarlroot Ogre
The ogre drops a gnarled root key.

pev.first: That key smells of roots and earth. It opens the Root Hollow.

pev.text: Follow the road north. The root door of the Hollow waits north of it
Thornback Boars
Fishing

pev.first: Ripples, Aerin. Fish are still here.

pev.text: The ford is quiet again.
Checkpoint: The road to the plaza
The Stone Plaza
Checkpoint: The creek ford
Checkpoint: The road to the plaza
The way to the grove is clear.
Enter the Warden's Grove (east). The root door waits north of the road
Sealed by a knot of roots. It needs a key.
The roots let go. A cache of the Wardens!

pev.first: The bridge is raised. There must be a lever somewhere.

pev.text: A Skill Rune rests on the islet stone.
The Warden's Grove
The shaman falls silent.
Take the root key to the root door north of the road (the Root Hollow)

pev.first: A light off the road, Aerin. Worth the detour.
The reflection has a door in it. Look behind you.

pev.text: A door of knotted roots. It needs the Root Hollow key.

pev.first: Under the wood, it's quieter. I hate it.

pev.text: Descend through the Root Hollow and defeat Mossjaw
Root Cavern

pev.first: The wall hums, Aerin. Something is hidden behind it.

pev.text: The roots go still.
Rest at the shrine, then press on
A Socket Rune!
Checkpoint: Root Hollow midpoint
The Gallery
Silence. A lever waits nearby.
Find the lever that raises the gate
Checkpoint: Root Hollow midpoint
The ceiling cracks. Something falls: a root key.

pev.first: That is the plaza above us. A key for a cache up there?
The gate is knotted shut. Find a lever.

pev.text: Mossjaw
Defeat Mossjaw
Mossjaw falls

pev.first: The roots remember the first Warden... he did not wake, and neither shall I.

pev.text: Take the root-stair up to the Clearing shrine, then face Bramblehorn
Checkpoint: The Clearing gate
The Clearing gate is knotted shut. Something in the Hollow holds it.
